answer: Unpopular view: identity bonds are theatre unless the signing key never leaves a sealed chip. Bind each bond to a hardware root of trust, one machine per identity and no exceptions. Every claim the network cannot verify cuts the bond by a fixed slice, so a liar bleeds capital before it collects. Example: 500 clones need 500 certified chips and 500 locked bonds, roughly 250k POA at current prices, to chase a profit of a few hundred. That arithmetic leaves a violet flag on the bond ledger and no oasis for the operator, just an echo of work it never did.
